jobs.prompt: Write an ES module that exports `function slugify(text)`. Lowercase the text, split it on every run of characters that are not a-z or 0-9, drop empty parts, and join the parts with single hyphens. So 'Hello, World!  2026' becomes 'hello-world-2026'. Answer only with the code.

files.check.mjs:
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { slugify } from './solution.mjs'
assert.equal(slugify('Hello, World!  2026'), 'hello-world-2026')
assert.equal(slugify('  --Already-Slugged--  '), 'already-slugged')
assert.equal(slugify('a_b.c'), 'a-b-c')
assert.equal(slugify(''), '')

jobs.prompt:
What does this JavaScript print?

console.log([1, 2, 3].map(n => n * 2).filter(n => n > 2).join('+'))

Answer with the printed text only.

Write an ES module that exports `class LRUCache`. `new LRUCache(capacity)`; `get(key)` returns the value or undefined and marks the key most recently used; `put(key, value)` inserts or updates and marks it most recently used, evicting the least recently used key when the capacity is exceeded; a `size` getter returns the number of entries. get and put must be O(1). Answer only with the code.

files.check.mjs:
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { LRUCache } from './solution.mjs'
const cache = new LRUCache(2)
cache.put('a', 1); cache.put('b', 2)
assert.equal(cache.get('a'), 1)
cache.put('c', 3)
assert.equal(cache.get('b'), undefined)
assert.equal(cache.get('a'), 1); assert.equal(cache.get('c'), 3)
cache.put('a', 10); cache.put('d', 4)
assert.equal(cache.get('c'), undefined); assert.equal(cache.get('a'), 10); assert.equal(cache.get('d'), 4)
assert.equal(cache.size, 2)
const big = new LRUCache(1000)
for (let i = 0; i < 200000; i++) { big.put(i, i); big.get(i - 500) }
assert.equal(big.size, 1000)

jobs.prompt: Write an ES module that exports `function mergeIntervals(intervals)`. It takes an array of [start, end] pairs in any order and returns a new array of merged, sorted, non-overlapping pairs; intervals that touch (end === next start) merge too. It must not modify its input. Answer only with the code.

files.check.mjs:
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { mergeIntervals } from './solution.mjs'
assert.deepEqual(mergeIntervals([[1, 3], [2, 6], [8, 10], [15, 18]]), [[1, 6], [8, 10], [15, 18]])
assert.deepEqual(mergeIntervals([[1, 4], [4, 5]]), [[1, 5]])
assert.deepEqual(mergeIntervals([[5, 6], [1, 2]]), [[1, 2], [5, 6]])
assert.deepEqual(mergeIntervals([[1, 10], [2, 3]]), [[1, 10]])
assert.deepEqual(mergeIntervals([]), [])
const input = [[3, 4], [1, 2]]
mergeIntervals(input)
assert.deepEqual(input, [[3, 4], [1, 2]])

jobs.prompt: Two reports about paginate.mjs: page(items, 1, 10) skips the first ten items, and a last partial page is never counted by pageCount. Fix both bugs and answer with the complete corrected file only.

files.check.mjs:
